content.short: AirPuff is an AirdropFi protocol for lending, leveraged points farming, and restaking-oriented yield strategies.
content.description: AirPuff is a DeFi protocol focused on turning airdrop and points opportunities into structured on-chain strategies. Users can participate as lenders seeking stable yield or as leveraged airdrop farmers who borrow from lending pools to amplify exposure to liquid restaking tokens, stablecoin opportunities, and other incentive campaigns. The platform combines lending markets, leverage, strategy containers, and points sharing so users can choose between lower-risk income and higher-risk reward farming. On Mantle, AirPuff provides access to airdrop-oriented yield products while keeping deposits and position management inside smart contracts.
content.meta: AirPuff combines lending, leverage, and airdrop farming strategies for DeFi users on Mantle.
